_comment: OpenBox / sing-box outbound tag -> public policy. Tag names only, never node details.
Put each tag under exactly one of DIRECT, PROXY, REJECT, DROP.
DROP = never publish rules that use this outbound (e.g. residential / chain exits).
Tags that appear nowhere here are 'unknown': their rules are skipped and reported
(or fail with --strict). Real node tags are intentionally NOT listed.
A NAS-local override file with the same layout can be passed via --outbound-map-override.
